---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL TPS == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL FST == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems
LOCAL NI  == INSTANCE NaturalsInduction
LOCAL SQT == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems

(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 1: cycle detection over a graph that admits a ranking function.    *)
(***************************************************************************)

GNodes(edges) == UNION {{edge[1], edge[2]} : edge \in edges}
GNbrs(edges, node) == {link[2] : link \in {outgoing \in edges : outgoing[1] = node}}
GStart(edges) == {link[1] : link \in edges}

GBody(edges, f, node) ==
  [visitedSet \in SUBSET GNodes(edges) |->
     IF node \in visitedSet THEN {node}
     ELSE UNION {f[nb][visitedSet \union {node}] : nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)}]

GFcn(edges) == CHOOSE f : f = [node \in GNodes(edges) |-> GBody(edges, f, node)]

HBody(edges, g, visited) ==
  [node \in GNodes(edges) |->
     IF node \in visited THEN {node}
     ELSE UNION {g[visited \union {node}][nb] : nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)}]

HFcn(edges) == CHOOSE g : g = [visited \in SUBSET GNodes(edges) |-> HBody(edges, g, visited)]

GRel(edges) == { ss \in (SUBSET GNodes(edges)) \X (SUBSET GNodes(edges)) :
                   ss[2] \subseteq ss[1] /\ ss[1] # ss[2] }

LEMMA GExpand ==
  ASSUME NEW edges
  PROVE  FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(edges) = UNION {GFcn(edges)[node][{}] : node \in GStart(edges)}
  BY DEF FindAllNodesInAnyCycle, GFcn, GBody, GNodes, GNbrs, GStart

LEMMA GNbrsInNodes ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW node, NEW nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)
  PROVE  nb \in GNodes(edges)
  BY DEF GNbrs, GNodes

LEMMA GStartInNodes ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW node \in GStart(edges)
  PROVE  node \in GNodes(edges)
  BY DEF GStart, GNodes

LEMMA GEdgeInNodes ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW e \in edges
  PROVE  /\ e[1] \in GNodes(edges)
         /\ e[2] \in GNodes(edges)
  BY DEF GNodes

LEMMA FiniteBridge == \A S : FST!IsFiniteSet(S) <=> IsFiniteSet(S)
  BY DEF FST!IsFiniteSet, IsFiniteSet

LEMMA GRelWF ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, IsFiniteSet(GNodes(edges))
  PROVE  FST!IsWellFoundedOn(GRel(edges), SUBSET GNodes(edges))
<1> DEFINE nd == GNodes(edges)
<1> DEFINE PI == FST!PreImage(LAMBDA s : nd \ s, SUBSET nd, FST!StrictSubsetOrdering(nd))
<1>1. FST!IsWellFoundedOn(FST!StrictSubsetOrdering(nd), FST!FiniteSubsetsOf(nd))
  BY FST!FS_StrictSubsetOrderingWellFounded
<1>2. \A s \in SUBSET nd : (nd \ s) \in FST!FiniteSubsetsOf(nd)
  <2>1. TAKE s \in SUBSET nd
  <2>2. IsFiniteSet(nd \ s)
    BY FST!FS_Subset, FiniteBridge
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2, FiniteBridge DEF FST!FiniteSubsetsOf
<1>3. FST!IsWellFoundedOn(PI, SUBSET nd)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, FST!PreImageWellFounded
<1>4. PI = GRel(edges)
  <2>1. PI = {ss \in (SUBSET nd) \X (SUBSET nd) :
                <<nd \ ss[1], nd \ ss[2]>> \in FST!StrictSubsetOrdering(nd)}
    BY DEF FST!PreImage
  <2>2. ASSUME NEW A \in SUBSET nd, NEW B \in SUBSET nd
        PROVE  (<<nd \ A, nd \ B>> \in FST!StrictSubsetOrdering(nd)) <=> (B \subseteq A /\ A # B)
    <3>1. <<nd \ A, nd \ B>> \in (SUBSET nd) \X (SUBSET nd)
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. ((nd \ A) \subseteq (nd \ B)) <=> (B \subseteq A)
      OBVIOUS
    <3>3. ((nd \ A) # (nd \ B)) <=> (A # B)
      <4>1. ASSUME (nd \ A) = (nd \ B) PROVE A = B
        <5>1. \A x : (x \in A) <=> (x \in B)
          BY <4>1
        <5>2. QED
          BY <5>1, TPS!SetExtensionality
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1
    <3>4. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <3>3 DEF FST!StrictSubsetOrdering
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF GRel
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA HFcnEq ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, IsFiniteSet(GNodes(edges))
  PROVE  HFcn(edges) = [visited \in SUBSET GNodes(edges) |-> HBody(edges, HFcn(edges), visited)]
<1> DEFINE nd == GNodes(edges)
<1> DEFINE S == SUBSET nd
<1> DEFINE R == GRel(edges)
<1> DEFINE Def(g, visited) == HBody(edges, g, visited)
<1>1. FST!IsWellFoundedOn(R, S)
  BY GRelWF
<1>2. FST!WFDefOn(R, S, Def)
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW g, NEW h, NEW x \in S,
                        \A y \in FST!SetLessThan(x, R, S) : g[y] = h[y]
                 PROVE  Def(g, x) = Def(h, x)
    BY DEF FST!WFDefOn
  <2>2. \A node \in nd : node \notin x => g[x \union {node}] = h[x \union {node}]
    <3>1. TAKE node \in nd
    <3>2. SUFFICES ASSUME node \notin x PROVE g[x \union {node}] = h[x \union {node}]
      OBVIOUS
    <3>3. (x \union {node}) \in FST!SetLessThan(x, R, S)
      BY <3>2 DEF FST!SetLessThan, GRel
    <3>4. QED
      BY <2>1, <3>3
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2 DEF HBody
<1>3. FST!OpDefinesFcn(HFcn(edges), S, Def)
  BY DEF FST!OpDefinesFcn, HFcn
<1>4. FST!WFInductiveDefines(HFcn(edges), S, Def)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, FST!WFInductiveDef
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4 DEF FST!WFInductiveDefines

LEMMA GFcnEq ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, IsFiniteSet(GNodes(edges))
  PROVE  GFcn(edges) = [node \in GNodes(edges) |-> GBody(edges, GFcn(edges), node)]
<1> DEFINE nd == GNodes(edges)
<1> DEFINE W == [node \in nd |-> [visited \in SUBSET nd |-> HFcn(edges)[visited][node]]]
<1>1. HFcn(edges) = [visited \in SUBSET nd |-> HBody(edges, HFcn(edges), visited)]
  BY HFcnEq
<1>2. W = [node \in nd |-> GBody(edges, W, node)]
  <2>1. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW node \in nd
                 PROVE  W[node] = GBody(edges, W, node)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW visited \in SUBSET nd
                 PROVE  W[node][visited] = GBody(edges, W, node)[visited]
    BY DEF GBody
  <2>3. W[node][visited] = HFcn(edges)[visited][node]
    OBVIOUS
  <2>4. HFcn(edges)[visited][node] =
          IF node \in visited THEN {node}
          ELSE UNION {HFcn(edges)[visited \union {node}][nb] : nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)}
    BY <1>1 DEF HBody
  <2>5. GBody(edges, W, node)[visited] =
          IF node \in visited THEN {node}
          ELSE UNION {W[nb][visited \union {node}] : nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)}
    BY DEF GBody
  <2>6. \A nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) : W[nb][visited \union {node}] = HFcn(edges)[visited \union {node}][nb]
    BY GNbrsInNodes
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6
<1>3. \E f : f = [node \in nd |-> GBody(edges, f, node)]
  BY <1>2
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>3 DEF GFcn

LEMMA GFcnEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW N \in Nat, NEW rank \in [GNodes(edges) -> 0..N],
         \A e \in edges : rank[e[1]] < rank[e[2]],
         IsFiniteSet(GNodes(edges))
  PROVE  \A node \in GNodes(edges) : \A visited \in SUBSET GNodes(edges) :
           (\A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node]) => GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
<1> DEFINE nd == GNodes(edges)
<1> DEFINE Q(k) == \A node \in nd : \A visited \in SUBSET nd :
                     (N - rank[node] <= k /\ \A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node])
                       => GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
<1>0. GFcn(edges) = [node \in nd |-> GBody(edges, GFcn(edges), node)]
  BY GFcnEq
<1>b. \A node \in nd : \A nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) :
         nb \in nd /\ rank[node] < rank[nb]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW node \in nd, NEW nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)
                PROVE  nb \in nd /\ rank[node] < rank[nb]
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. nb \in nd
    BY GNbrsInNodes
  <2>2. PICK link \in edges : link[1] = node /\ nb = link[2]
    BY DEF GNbrs
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>a. \A node \in nd : \A visited \in SUBSET nd :
         ( (\A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node])
           /\ (\A nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) : GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}] = {}) )
         => GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW node \in nd, NEW visited \in SUBSET nd,
                       \A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node],
                       \A nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) : GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}] = {}
                PROVE  GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. rank[node] \in 0..N
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. node \notin visited
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME node \in visited PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. rank[node] < rank[node]
      OBVIOUS
    <3>3. QED
      BY <2>1, <3>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
  <2>3. GFcn(edges)[node][visited]
          = UNION {GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}] : nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)}
    BY <1>0, <2>2 DEF GBody
  <2>4. \A z : z \notin GFcn(edges)[node][visited]
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW z, z \in GFcn(edges)[node][visited] PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. PICK nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) : z \in GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}]
      BY <2>3
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>2
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>4, TPS!SetExtensionality
<1>1. Q(0)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW node \in nd, NEW visited \in SUBSET nd,
                       N - rank[node] <= 0,
                       \A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node]
                PROVE  GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. rank[node] \in 0..N
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. GNbrs(edges, node) = {}
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) PROVE FALSE
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. nb \in nd /\ rank[node] < rank[nb]
      BY <1>b
    <3>3. rank[nb] \in 0..N
      BY <3>2
    <3>4. QED
      BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r20")
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>a, <2>2
<1>2. \A n \in Nat : Q(n) => Q(n+1)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in Nat, Q(n),
                       NEW node \in nd, NEW visited \in SUBSET nd,
                       N - rank[node] <= n+1,
                       \A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node]
                PROVE  GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. rank[node] \in 0..N
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. \A nb \in GNbrs(edges, node) : GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}] = {}
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW nb \in GNbrs(edges, node)
                  PROVE  GFcn(edges)[nb][visited \union {node}] = {}
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. nb \in nd /\ rank[node] < rank[nb]
      BY <1>b
    <3>3. rank[nb] \in 0..N
      BY <3>2
    <3>4. N - rank[nb] <= n
      BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r20")
    <3>5. (visited \union {node}) \in SUBSET nd
      OBVIOUS
    <3>6. \A v \in visited \union {node} : rank[v] < rank[nb]
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW v \in visited \union {node} PROVE rank[v] < rank[nb]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. CASE v = node
        BY <3>2, <4>2
      <4>3. CASE v \in visited
        <5>1. rank[v] < rank[node]
          BY <4>3
        <5>2. rank[v] \in 0..N
          BY <4>3
        <5>3. QED
          BY <2>1, <3>2, <3>3, <5>1, <5>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>4. QED
        BY <4>2, <4>3
    <3>7. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>a, <2>2
<1>3. HIDE DEF Q
<1>4. \A n \in Nat : Q(n)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, NI!NatInduction
<1>5. QED
  <2>0. USE DEF Q
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW node \in nd, NEW visited \in SUBSET nd,
                       \A v \in visited : rank[v] < rank[node]
                PROVE  GFcn(edges)[node][visited] = {}
    OBVIOUS
  <2>4. rank[node] \in 0..N
    OBVIOUS
  <2>5. N - rank[node] \in Nat /\ N - rank[node] <= N - rank[node]
    BY <2>4, TPS!SMTT("r20")
  <2>6. QED
    BY <1>4, <2>5

THEOREM GNoCycle ==
  ASSUME NEW edges, NEW N \in Nat, NEW rank \in [GNodes(edges) -> 0..N],
         \A e \in edges : rank[e[1]] < rank[e[2]],
         IsFiniteSet(GNodes(edges))
  PROVE  FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(edges) = {}
<1>1. \A node \in GStart(edges) : GFcn(edges)[node][{}] = {}
  BY GFcnEmpty, GStartInNodes
<1>2. FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(edges) = UNION {GFcn(edges)[node][{}] : node \in GStart(edges)}
  BY GExpand
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2

(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 2: NoLock is outside Key and TxnId.                                *)
(***************************************************************************)

LEMMA AgNoUniversalSet ==
  ASSUME NEW SS
  PROVE  \E x : x \notin SS
<1> DEFINE R == {x \in SS : x \notin x}
<1>1. R \notin SS
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME R \in SS PROVE FALSE
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. (R \in R) <=> (R \in SS /\ R \notin R)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1

LEMMA AgNoLockNotKey == NoLock \notin Key /\ NoLock \notin TxnId
<1>1. \E x : x \notin (Key \union TxnId)
  BY AgNoUniversalSet
<1>2. NoLock \notin (Key \union TxnId)
  BY <1>1 DEF NoLock
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2


(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 3: SelectSeq is a monotone embedding of the filtered positions.    *)
(***************************************************************************)

AgEmb(sq, ff, Test(_)) ==
  /\ ff \in [1..Len(SelectSeq(sq,Test)) -> 1..Len(sq)]
  /\ \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(sq,Test)) : SelectSeq(sq,Test)[i] = sq[ff[i]]
  /\ \A i, j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(sq,Test)) : i < j => ff[i] < ff[j]
  /\ \A k \in 1..Len(sq) : Test(sq[k]) => \E i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(sq,Test)) : ff[i] = k

LEMMA AgSelSeqEmpty ==
  ASSUME NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  SelectSeq(<<>>, Test) = <<>>
  BY TPS!SMTT("r10") DEF SelectSeq

LEMMA AgSelSeqAppend ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  SelectSeq(Append(sq,e), Test)
           = IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(sq,Test), e) ELSE SelectSeq(sq, Test)
  BY TPS!SMTT("r20") DEF SelectSeq

LEMMA AgSelSeqType ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  SelectSeq(sq, Test) \in Seq(S)
  BY TPS!SMTT("r20") DEF SelectSeq

LEMMA AgSelSeqEmbed ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  \E ff : AgEmb(sq, ff, Test)
<1> DEFINE P(u) == \E ff : AgEmb(u, ff, Test)
<1>1. P(<<>>)
  <2>1. SelectSeq(<<>>, Test) = <<>>
    BY AgSelSeqEmpty
  <2>2. Len(<<>>) = 0
    OBVIOUS
  <2>3. AgEmb(<<>>, <<>>, Test)
    BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgEmb
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>3
<1>2. \A u \in Seq(S), e \in S : P(u) => P(Append(u,e))
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW u \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, NEW ff, AgEmb(u, ff, Test)
                PROVE  \E gg : AgEmb(Append(u,e), gg, Test)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. /\ Len(Append(u,e)) = Len(u) + 1
        /\ \A i \in 1..Len(u) : Append(u,e)[i] = u[i]
        /\ Append(u,e)[Len(u)+1] = e
        /\ Append(u,e) \in Seq(S)
    BY SQT!AppendProperties
  <2>2. Len(u) \in Nat /\ Len(SelectSeq(u,Test)) \in Nat
    BY AgSelSeqType, SQT!LenProperties
  <2>3. SelectSeq(Append(u,e), Test)
          = IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(u,Test), e) ELSE SelectSeq(u, Test)
    BY AgSelSeqAppend
  <2>4. CASE Test(e)
    <3> DEFINE m == Len(SelectSeq(u,Test))
    <3> DEFINE gg == Append(ff, Len(u)+1)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(u,e), Test) = Append(SelectSeq(u,Test), e)
      BY <2>3, <2>4
    <3>2. /\ Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) = m + 1
          /\ \A i \in 1..m : SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[i] = SelectSeq(u,Test)[i]
          /\ SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[m+1] = e
      BY <3>1, <2>2, AgSelSeqType, SQT!AppendProperties
    <3>3. ff \in [1..m -> 1..Len(u)]
      BY DEF AgEmb
    <3>3a. ff \in Seq(1..(Len(u)+1))
      <4>1. ff \in [1..m -> 1..(Len(u)+1)]
        BY <3>3, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1, <2>2, SQT!SeqDef
    <3>3b. Len(ff) = m
      BY <3>3, <2>2, SQT!LenProperties, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3c. Len(u)+1 \in 1..(Len(u)+1)
      BY <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>4. /\ Len(gg) = m + 1
          /\ \A i \in 1..m : gg[i] = ff[i]
          /\ gg[m+1] = Len(u)+1
          /\ gg \in [1..(m+1) -> 1..(Len(u)+1)]
      <4>1. /\ gg \in Seq(1..(Len(u)+1))
            /\ Len(gg) = Len(ff)+1
            /\ \A i \in 1..Len(ff) : gg[i] = ff[i]
            /\ gg[Len(ff)+1] = Len(u)+1
        BY <3>3a, <3>3c, SQT!AppendProperties
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1, <3>3b, SQT!LenProperties
    <3>5. gg \in [1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) -> 1..Len(Append(u,e))]
      BY <3>2, <3>4, <2>1
    <3>6. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) :
             SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[i] = Append(u,e)[gg[i]]
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..(m+1)
                    PROVE  SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[i] = Append(u,e)[gg[i]]
        BY <3>2
      <4>1. CASE i \in 1..m
        <5>1. SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[i] = SelectSeq(u,Test)[i]
          BY <3>2, <4>1
        <5>2. SelectSeq(u,Test)[i] = u[ff[i]]
          BY <4>1 DEF AgEmb
        <5>3. ff[i] \in 1..Len(u)
          BY <3>3, <4>1
        <5>4. Append(u,e)[gg[i]] = Append(u,e)[ff[i]]
          BY <3>4, <4>1
        <5>5. QED
          BY <5>1, <5>2, <5>3, <5>4, <2>1
      <4>2. CASE i = m+1
        BY <3>2, <3>4, <2>1, <4>2
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
    <3>7. \A i, j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) : i < j => gg[i] < gg[j]
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..(m+1), NEW j \in 1..(m+1), i < j
                    PROVE  gg[i] < gg[j]
        BY <3>2
      <4>1. i \in 1..m
        BY <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>2. CASE j \in 1..m
        <5>1. ff[i] < ff[j]
          BY <4>1, <4>2 DEF AgEmb
        <5>2. QED
          BY <5>1, <3>4, <4>1, <4>2
      <4>3. CASE j = m+1
        <5>1. ff[i] \in 1..Len(u)
          BY <3>3, <4>1
        <5>2. QED
          BY <5>1, <3>4, <4>1, <4>3, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>4. QED
        BY <4>2, <4>3, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
    <3>8. \A k \in 1..Len(Append(u,e)) :
             Test(Append(u,e)[k]) => \E i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) : gg[i] = k
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(Len(u)+1), Test(Append(u,e)[k])
                    PROVE  \E i \in 1..(m+1) : gg[i] = k
        BY <2>1, <3>2
      <4>1. CASE k \in 1..Len(u)
        <5>1. Test(u[k])
          BY <4>1, <2>1
        <5>2. PICK i \in 1..m : ff[i] = k
          BY <5>1, <4>1 DEF AgEmb
        <5>3. QED
          BY <5>2, <3>4, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>2. CASE k = Len(u)+1
        BY <3>4, <4>2, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>1, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
    <3>9. QED
      BY <3>5, <3>6, <3>7, <3>8 DEF AgEmb
  <2>5. CASE ~Test(e)
    <3> DEFINE m == Len(SelectSeq(u,Test))
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(u,e), Test) = SelectSeq(u,Test)
      BY <2>3, <2>5
    <3>2. ff \in [1..m -> 1..Len(u)]
      BY DEF AgEmb
    <3>3. ff \in [1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) -> 1..Len(Append(u,e))]
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>1, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
    <3>4. \A i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) :
             SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)[i] = Append(u,e)[ff[i]]
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m
                    PROVE  SelectSeq(u,Test)[i] = Append(u,e)[ff[i]]
        BY <3>1
      <4>1. SelectSeq(u,Test)[i] = u[ff[i]]
        BY DEF AgEmb
      <4>2. ff[i] \in 1..Len(u)
        BY <3>2
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>1
    <3>5. \A i, j \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) : i < j => ff[i] < ff[j]
      BY <3>1 DEF AgEmb
    <3>6. \A k \in 1..Len(Append(u,e)) :
             Test(Append(u,e)[k]) => \E i \in 1..Len(SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test)) : ff[i] = k
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW k \in 1..(Len(u)+1), Test(Append(u,e)[k])
                    PROVE  \E i \in 1..m : ff[i] = k
        BY <2>1, <3>1
      <4>1. k # Len(u)+1
        BY <2>1, <2>5
      <4>2. k \in 1..Len(u)
        BY <4>1, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r20")
      <4>3. Test(u[k])
        BY <4>2, <2>1
      <4>4. QED
        BY <4>3, <4>2 DEF AgEmb
    <3>7. QED
      BY <3>3, <3>4, <3>5, <3>6 DEF AgEmb
  <2>6. QED
    BY <2>4, <2>5
<1>3. HIDE DEF P
<1>4. \A u \in Seq(S) : P(u)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SQT!SequencesInductionAppend
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4 DEF P


(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 4: indices in a duplicate-free sequence.                           *)
(***************************************************************************)

AgNoDup(sq) == \A i, j \in 1..Len(sq) : sq[i] = sq[j] => i = j

LEMMA AgRangeBridge == \A f : SQT!Range(f) = Range(f)
  BY DEF SQT!Range, Range

LEMMA AgIdxNotIn ==
  ASSUME NEW sq, NEW r, r \notin Range(sq)
  PROVE  IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, r) = -1
  BY DEF IndexOfOpInHistory

LEMMA AgIdxIn ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), NEW r \in Range(sq)
  PROVE  /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, r) \in 1..Len(sq)
         /\ sq[IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, r)] = r
<1>1. Range(sq) = { sq[i] : i \in 1..Len(sq) }
  BY SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
<1>2. \E i \in 1..Len(sq) : sq[i] = r
  BY <1>1
<1>3. IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, r) = CHOOSE i \in 1..Len(sq) : sq[i] = r
  BY DEF IndexOfOpInHistory
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgIdxUnique ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), AgNoDup(sq), NEW i \in 1..Len(sq)
  PROVE  IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, sq[i]) = i
<1>1. sq[i] \in Range(sq)
  BY SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
<1>2. /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, sq[i]) \in 1..Len(sq)
      /\ sq[IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, sq[i])] = sq[i]
  BY <1>1, AgIdxIn
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2 DEF AgNoDup


(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 5: the committed-only projection of the history.                   *)
(***************************************************************************)

AgCHist == SelectSeq(history, LAMBDA e : e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(history))

LEMMA AgSelSeqRange ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  Range(SelectSeq(sq,Test)) = {e \in Range(sq) : Test(e)}
<1> DEFINE P(u) == Range(SelectSeq(u,Test)) = {e \in Range(u) : Test(e)}
<1>1. P(<<>>)
  <2>1. SelectSeq(<<>>, Test) = <<>>
    BY AgSelSeqEmpty
  <2>2. Range(<<>>) = {}
    BY DEF Range
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. \A u \in Seq(S), e \in S : P(u) => P(Append(u,e))
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW u \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, P(u)
                PROVE  P(Append(u,e))
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. Range(Append(u,e)) = Range(u) \cup {e}
    BY SQT!AppendProperties, AgRangeBridge
  <2>2. SelectSeq(Append(u,e), Test)
          = IF Test(e) THEN Append(SelectSeq(u,Test), e) ELSE SelectSeq(u, Test)
    BY AgSelSeqAppend
  <2>3. CASE Test(e)
    <3>1. SelectSeq(Append(u,e),Test) = Append(SelectSeq(u,Test), e)
      BY <2>2, <2>3
    <3>2. Range(Append(SelectSeq(u,Test), e)) = Range(SelectSeq(u,Test)) \cup {e}
      BY AgSelSeqType, SQT!AppendProperties, AgRangeBridge
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>1, <2>3
  <2>4. CASE ~Test(e)
    BY <2>2, <2>4, <2>1
  <2>5. QED
    BY <2>3, <2>4
<1>3. HIDE DEF P
<1>4. \A u \in Seq(S) : P(u)
  BY <1>1, <1>2, SQT!SequencesInductionAppend
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4 DEF P

LEMMA AgChFacts ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S), AgNoDup(history)
  PROVE  /\ AgCHist \in Seq(S)
         /\ AgNoDup(AgCHist)
         /\ Range(AgCHist) = {e \in Range(history) : e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(history)}
         /\ \A r1, r2 \in Range(AgCHist) :
               IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)
                 => IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2)
<1> DEFINE Tst(e) == e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(history)
<1> DEFINE m == Len(AgCHist)
<1> DEFINE n == Len(history)
<1>1. AgCHist \in Seq(S)
  BY AgSelSeqType DEF AgCHist
<1>2. PICK ff : AgEmb(history, ff, Tst)
  BY AgSelSeqEmbed
<1>3. /\ ff \in [1..m -> 1..n]
      /\ \A i \in 1..m : AgCHist[i] = history[ff[i]]
      /\ \A i, j \in 1..m : i < j => ff[i] < ff[j]
  BY <1>2 DEF AgEmb, AgCHist
<1>4. \A i \in 1..m : IndexOfOpInHistory(history, AgCHist[i]) = ff[i]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m PROVE IndexOfOpInHistory(history, history[ff[i]]) = ff[i]
    BY <1>3
  <2>1. ff[i] \in 1..n
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, AgIdxUnique
<1>5. AgNoDup(AgCHist)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m, NEW j \in 1..m, AgCHist[i] = AgCHist[j]
                PROVE  i = j
    BY DEF AgNoDup
  <2>1. ff[i] = ff[j]
    BY <1>4, <1>3
  <2>2. ~(i < j) /\ ~(j < i)
    BY <1>3, <2>1
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2, <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r20")
<1>6. Range(AgCHist) = {e \in Range(history) : e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(history)}
  BY AgSelSeqRange DEF AgCHist
<1>7. \A r1, r2 \in Range(AgCHist) :
         IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)
           => IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW r1 \in Range(AgCHist), NEW r2 \in Range(AgCHist),
                       IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)
                PROVE  IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1) \in 1..m
        /\ AgCHist[IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1)] = r1
        /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2) \in 1..m
        /\ AgCHist[IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)] = r2
    BY <1>1, AgIdxIn
  <2>2. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) = ff[IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1)]
    BY <1>4, <2>1
  <2>3. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2) = ff[IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)]
    BY <1>4, <2>1
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>3, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3
<1>8. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7


(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 6: the MVSG of a state satisfying the safety invariant is acyclic. *)
(***************************************************************************)

AgReasons == { "voluntary",
               "in attempted commit, to preserve serializability",
               "in attempted read, to preserve serializability",
               "in attempted write, to preserve serializability",
               "forced by First Committer Wins",
               "forced by deadlock-prevention" }

AgEvSet == [op : {"begin","commit"}, txnid : TxnId]
             \union [op : {"abort"}, txnid : TxnId, reason : AgReasons]
             \union [op : {"write"}, txnid : TxnId, key : Key]
             \union [op : {"read"}, txnid : TxnId, key : Key, ver : TxnId]

AgEvB(t)    == [op |-> "begin",  txnid |-> t]
AgEvC(t)    == [op |-> "commit", txnid |-> t]
AgEvW(t,k)  == [op |-> "write",  txnid |-> t, key |-> k]

AgBH(t) == IndexOfOpInHistory(history, AgEvB(t))
AgCX(t) == IndexOfOpInHistory(history, AgEvC(t))
AgRD(t) == KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(history, t, "read")

AgCPos(t) == IF t \in AbortedTxns(history) THEN 0
             ELSE IF AgEvC(t) \in Range(history) THEN AgCX(t)
             ELSE Len(history) + 1

AgPreConc(t1,t2) ==
  /\ t1 # t2
  /\ \E k \in Key : /\ k \in AgRD(t1)
                    /\ AgEvW(t2,k) \in Range(history)
                    /\ AgBH(t1) < AgCPos(t2)
                    /\ AgBH(t2) < AgCPos(t1)

AgHasOut(t) == \E t2 \in TxnId : AgPreConc(t, t2)
AgHasIn(t)  == \E t1 \in TxnId : AgPreConc(t1, t)

AgWIc(t,k) == IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist, AgEvW(t,k))
AgBIc(t)   == IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist, AgEvB(t))
AgCIc(t)   == IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist, AgEvC(t))
AgRDc(t)   == KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(AgCHist, t, "read")

AgD1(t1,t2,x) == AgWIc(t1,x) # -1 /\ AgWIc(t2,x) # -1 /\ AgWIc(t1,x) < AgWIc(t2,x)
AgD2(t1,t2,x) == AgWIc(t1,x) # -1 /\ x \in AgRDc(t2) /\ AgCIc(t1) < AgBIc(t2)
AgD3(t1,t2,x) == x \in AgRD(t1) /\ AgWIc(t2,x) # -1 /\ AgBIc(t1) < AgCIc(t2)

AgMVSG == {tp \in CommittedTxns(history) \X CommittedTxns(history) :
             /\ tp[1] # tp[2]
             /\ \E x \in Key : \/ AgD1(tp[1],tp[2],x)
                                \/ AgD2(tp[1],tp[2],x)
                                \/ AgD3(tp[1],tp[2],x)}

AgSafeInv ==
  /\ history \in Seq(AgEvSet)
  /\ AgNoDup(history)
  /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(history) :
        /\ t \in TxnId
        /\ AgEvB(t) \in Range(history)
        /\ AgEvC(t) \in Range(history)
        /\ t \notin AbortedTxns(history)
        /\ AgBH(t) < AgCX(t)
  /\ \A t1, t2 \in CommittedTxns(history) : \A k \in Key :
        (  /\ t1 # t2
           /\ AgEvW(t1,k) \in Range(history)
           /\ AgEvW(t2,k) \in Range(history)
           /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t1,k)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,k)) )
        => AgCX(t1) < AgBH(t2)
  /\ \A t \in CommittedTxns(history) : ~(AgHasIn(t) /\ AgHasOut(t))

LEMMA AgMVSGEq == CahillMVSG(history) = AgMVSG
  BY DEF CahillMVSG, AgMVSG, AgCHist, AgWIc, AgBIc, AgCIc, AgRD, AgRDc,
         AgEvW, AgEvB, AgEvC, AgD1, AgD2, AgD3

LEMMA AgCtFinite ==
  ASSUME NEW S, history \in Seq(S)
  PROVE  IsFiniteSet(CommittedTxns(history))
<1>1. IsFiniteSet(1..Len(history))
  BY FST!FS_Interval, FiniteBridge, SQT!LenProperties
<1>2. Range(history) = { history[i] : i \in 1..Len(history) }
  BY SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
<1>3. IsFiniteSet(Range(history))
  <2>1. history \in [1..Len(history) -> Range(history)]
    <3>1. history \in [1..Len(history) -> S]
      BY SQT!LenProperties
    <3>2. \A i \in 1..Len(history) : history[i] \in Range(history)
      BY <1>2
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>2. history \in FST!Surjection(1..Len(history), Range(history))
    <3>1. \A y \in Range(history) : \E i \in 1..Len(history) : history[i] = y
      BY <1>2
    <3>2. QED
      BY <2>1, <3>1 DEF FST!Surjection
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>2, FST!FS_Surjection, FiniteBridge
<1>4. IsFiniteSet(SelectEvents(history, LAMBDA e : e.op \in {"commit"}))
  <2>1. SelectEvents(history, LAMBDA e : e.op \in {"commit"}) \in SUBSET Range(history)
    BY DEF SelectEvents
  <2>2. QED
    BY <1>3, <2>1, FST!FS_Subset, FiniteBridge
<1>5. QED
  BY <1>4, FST!FS_Image, FiniteBridge DEF CommittedTxns

LEMMA AgSafe == AgSafeInv => CahillSerializable(history)
<1>. SUFFICES ASSUME AgSafeInv PROVE FindAllNodesInAnyCycle(CahillMVSG(history)) = {}
  BY DEF CahillSerializable, IsCycle
<1> DEFINE ct == CommittedTxns(history)
<1> DEFINE ed == CahillMVSG(history)
<1> DEFINE NN == 2 * Len(history) + 1
<1> DEFINE rk == [t \in GNodes(ed) |-> IF AgHasOut(t) THEN 2*AgBH(t) ELSE 2*AgCX(t)+1]
<1>len. Len(history) \in Nat
  BY SQT!LenProperties DEF AgSafeInv
<1>ct. \A t \in ct : /\ t \in TxnId
                     /\ AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history)
                     /\ AgCX(t) \in 1..Len(history)
                     /\ AgBH(t) < AgCX(t)
                     /\ AgCPos(t) = AgCX(t)
                     /\ history[AgBH(t)] = AgEvB(t)
                     /\ history[AgCX(t)] = AgEvC(t)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t \in ct
                PROVE  /\ t \in TxnId
                       /\ AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history)
                       /\ AgCX(t) \in 1..Len(history)
                       /\ AgBH(t) < AgCX(t)
                       /\ AgCPos(t) = AgCX(t)
                       /\ history[AgBH(t)] = AgEvB(t)
                       /\ history[AgCX(t)] = AgEvC(t)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. /\ t \in TxnId
        /\ AgEvB(t) \in Range(history)
        /\ AgEvC(t) \in Range(history)
        /\ t \notin AbortedTxns(history)
        /\ AgBH(t) < AgCX(t)
    BY DEF AgSafeInv
  <2>2. /\ AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history)
        /\ history[AgBH(t)] = AgEvB(t)
        /\ AgCX(t) \in 1..Len(history)
        /\ history[AgCX(t)] = AgEvC(t)
    BY <2>1, AgIdxIn DEF AgBH, AgCX, AgSafeInv
  <2>3. AgCPos(t) = AgCX(t)
    BY <2>1 DEF AgCPos
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3
<1>nodes. GNodes(ed) \subseteq ct
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t \in GNodes(ed) PROVE t \in ct
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. PICK e \in ed : t = e[1] \/ t = e[2]
    BY DEF GNodes
  <2>2. e \in ct \X ct
    BY <2>1, AgMVSGEq DEF AgMVSG
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>fin. IsFiniteSet(GNodes(ed))
  <2>1. IsFiniteSet(ct)
    BY AgCtFinite DEF AgSafeInv
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>nodes, FST!FS_Subset, FiniteBridge
<1>rk. rk \in [GNodes(ed) -> 0..NN]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t \in GNodes(ed)
                PROVE  (IF AgHasOut(t) THEN 2*AgBH(t) ELSE 2*AgCX(t)+1) \in 0..NN
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. t \in ct
    BY <1>nodes
  <2>2. AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history) /\ AgCX(t) \in 1..Len(history)
    BY <2>1, <1>ct
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2, <1>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>chf. /\ AgCHist \in Seq(AgEvSet)
        /\ AgNoDup(AgCHist)
        /\ Range(AgCHist) = {e \in Range(history) : e.txnid \in ct}
        /\ \A r1, r2 \in Range(AgCHist) :
              IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(AgCHist,r2)
                => IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2)
  BY AgChFacts DEF AgSafeInv
<1>inR. \A t \in ct : AgEvB(t) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvC(t) \in Range(AgCHist)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t \in ct
                PROVE  AgEvB(t) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvC(t) \in Range(AgCHist)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. AgEvB(t) \in Range(history) /\ AgEvC(t) \in Range(history)
    BY DEF AgSafeInv
  <2>2. AgEvB(t).txnid = t /\ AgEvC(t).txnid = t
    BY DEF AgEvB, AgEvC
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>chf
<1>wIn. \A t, k : AgWIc(t,k) # -1 => AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(history)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t, NEW k, AgWIc(t,k) # -1
                PROVE  AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(history)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(AgCHist)
    BY AgIdxNotIn DEF AgWIc
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>chf
<1>ord. \A t1, t2 \in ct : AgCIc(t1) < AgBIc(t2) => AgCX(t1) < AgBH(t2)
  BY <1>inR, <1>chf DEF AgCIc, AgBIc, AgCX, AgBH
<1>D. \A e \in ed : rk[e[1]] < rk[e[2]]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW ee \in ed PROVE rk[ee[1]] < rk[ee[2]]
    OBVIOUS
  <2> DEFINE T1 == ee[1]
  <2> DEFINE T2 == ee[2]
  <2>1. T1 \in ct /\ T2 \in ct /\ T1 # T2
    BY AgMVSGEq DEF AgMVSG
  <2>2. T1 \in GNodes(ed) /\ T2 \in GNodes(ed)
    BY GEdgeInNodes
  <2>3. PICK x \in Key : AgD1(T1,T2,x) \/ AgD2(T1,T2,x) \/ AgD3(T1,T2,x)
    BY AgMVSGEq DEF AgMVSG
  <2>bc. /\ AgBH(T1) \in 1..Len(history) /\ AgCX(T1) \in 1..Len(history) /\ AgBH(T1) < AgCX(T1)
         /\ AgBH(T2) \in 1..Len(history) /\ AgCX(T2) \in 1..Len(history) /\ AgBH(T2) < AgCX(T2)
    BY <2>1, <1>ct
  <2>fw. ASSUME AgCX(T1) < AgBH(T2) PROVE rk[T1] < rk[T2]
    <3>1. rk[T1] = IF AgHasOut(T1) THEN 2*AgBH(T1) ELSE 2*AgCX(T1)+1
      BY <2>2
    <3>2. rk[T2] = IF AgHasOut(T2) THEN 2*AgBH(T2) ELSE 2*AgCX(T2)+1
      BY <2>2
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>bc, <2>fw, <1>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
  <2>4. CASE AgD3(T1,T2,x) /\ AgBH(T2) < AgCX(T1)
    <3>1. AgEvW(T2,x) \in Range(history)
      BY <2>4, <1>wIn DEF AgD3
    <3>2. AgBH(T1) < AgCX(T2)
      <4>1. AgBIc(T1) < AgCIc(T2)
        BY <2>4 DEF AgD3
      <4>2. AgEvB(T1) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvC(T2) \in Range(AgCHist)
        BY <2>1, <1>inR
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <1>chf DEF AgBIc, AgCIc, AgBH, AgCX
    <3>3. AgPreConc(T1,T2)
      <4>1. x \in AgRD(T1)
        BY <2>4 DEF AgD3
      <4>2. AgCPos(T2) = AgCX(T2) /\ AgCPos(T1) = AgCX(T1)
        BY <2>1, <1>ct
      <4>3. QED
        BY <2>1, <3>1, <3>2, <4>1, <4>2, <2>4 DEF AgPreConc
    <3>4. AgHasOut(T1) /\ AgHasIn(T2)
      BY <3>3, <2>1, <1>ct DEF AgHasOut, AgHasIn
    <3>5. ~AgHasOut(T2)
      BY <3>4, <2>1 DEF AgSafeInv
    <3>6. rk[T1] = 2*AgBH(T1) /\ rk[T2] = 2*AgCX(T2)+1
      BY <2>2, <3>4, <3>5
    <3>7. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>6, <2>bc, <1>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
  <2>5. CASE AgD1(T1,T2,x)
    <3>1. AgEvW(T1,x) \in Range(history) /\ AgEvW(T2,x) \in Range(history)
      BY <2>5, <1>wIn DEF AgD1
    <3>2. AgEvW(T1,x) \in Range(AgCHist) /\ AgEvW(T2,x) \in Range(AgCHist)
      BY <2>5, <1>wIn DEF AgD1
    <3>3. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(T1,x)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(T2,x))
      BY <2>5, <3>2, <1>chf DEF AgD1, AgWIc

AgFCWRec(t) == [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> t, reason |-> "forced by First Committer Wins"]

AgBAOSFcn(Txns) ==
  CHOOSE BuildAbortOpSeq : BuildAbortOpSeq = [RemainingTxns \in SUBSET Txns |->
      IF RemainingTxns = {} THEN
          <<>>

          LET t == CHOOSE t \in RemainingTxns : TRUE

    <3>11. QED
      BY <3>7, <3>9, <3>10
  <2>3. QED

<1>wf. FST!IsWellFoundedOn(FST!StrictSubsetOrdering(Txns), SUBSET Txns)

(***************************************************************************)
(* Part 8: the deadlock-detection walk of HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock.   *)
(***************************************************************************)

AgWR(t) == KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(history, t, "write")

AgTypeOK ==
  /\ history \in Seq(AgEvSet)
  /\ holdingXLocks \in [TxnId -> SUBSET Key]
  /\ waitingForXLock \in [TxnId -> Key \union {NoLock}]
  /\ inConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ outConflict \in [TxnId -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ holdingSIREADlocks \in [TxnId -> SUBSET Key]

AgLockInv ==
  /\ \A t \in TxnId : holdingXLocks[t] = IF t \in ActiveTxns(history) THEN AgWR(t) ELSE {}
  /\ \A t1, t2 \in TxnId, k \in Key :
        (k \in holdingXLocks[t1] /\ k \in holdingXLocks[t2]) => t1 = t2

AgWaitRel == {pr \in TxnId \X TxnId : waitingForXLock[pr[2]] \in holdingXLocks[pr[1]]}
AgWaitInv == FST!IsWellFoundedOn(AgWaitRel, TxnId)

AgActive == ActiveTxns(history)

AgXHeld == [k \in Key |->
              LET holder == {t \in ActiveTxns(history) : k \in KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn(t)}
              IN  IF holder /= {} THEN CHOOSE t \in holder : TRUE
                                  ELSE NoLock]

AgPropW(txn, key) == [waitingForXLock EXCEPT ![txn] = key]

AgEdges(txn, key) ==
  {waitEdge \in ActiveTxns(history) \X ActiveTxns(history) :
      LET from == waitEdge[1] to == waitEdge[2] IN
      \E k \in Key : /\ AgPropW(txn,key)[from] = k
                     /\ AgXHeld[k]              = to}

AgNEPaths == {path \in Seq(ActiveTxns(history)) : Len(path) > 0}

AgEPBody(txn, key, f, currPath) ==
  LET from == currPath[Len(currPath)]
      outgoingEdges == {candidateEdge \in AgEdges(txn,key) : candidateEdge[1] = from}
  IN  IF outgoingEdges = {}
      THEN {}
      ELSE LET edge == CHOOSE selectedEdge \in outgoingEdges : TRUE
           IN  IF edge[2] = txn THEN {currPath}
                                ELSE f[Append(currPath, edge[2])]

AgEP(txn, key) ==
  CHOOSE extendPath : extendPath = [currPath \in AgNEPaths |-> AgEPBody(txn,key,extendPath,currPath)]

AgCyc(txn, key) == AgEP(txn,key)[<<txn>>]

LEMMA AgTxnIds ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK
  PROVE  /\ Range(history) \subseteq AgEvSet
         /\ \A e \in Range(history) : e.txnid \in TxnId
         /\ ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
         /\ ActiveTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
         /\ CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
         /\ AbortedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
<1>1. Range(history) \subseteq AgEvSet
  BY SQT!RangeOfSeq, AgRangeBridge DEF AgTypeOK
<1>2. \A e \in Range(history) : e.txnid \in TxnId
  BY <1>1 DEF AgEvSet
<1>3. ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
  BY <1>2 DEF ActiveOrFinalizedTxns
<1>4. ActiveTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
  BY <1>3 DEF ActiveTxns
<1>5. CommittedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
  BY <1>2 DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents
<1>6. AbortedTxns(history) \subseteq TxnId
  BY <1>2 DEF AbortedTxns, SelectEvents
<1>7. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6

LEMMA AgHWCUnfold ==
  ASSUME NEW txn, NEW key
  PROVE  HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock(txn, key) =
           (IF AgCyc(txn,key) = {} THEN
              /\ waitingForXLock' = [waitingForXLock EXCEPT ![txn] = key]
              /\ UNCHANGED <<history, holdingXLocks, inConflict, outConflict, holdingSIREADlocks>>
            ELSE
              \E to_abort \in Range(CHOOSE anyPathSeq \in AgCyc(txn,key) : TRUE) :
                /\ history' = Append(history, [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> to_abort,
                                               reason |-> "forced by deadlock-prevention"])
                /\ IF to_abort = txn THEN
                     /\ holdingXLocks' = [holdingXLocks EXCEPT ![txn] = {}]
                     /\ UNCHANGED <<waitingForXLock>>
                   ELSE
                     /\ holdingXLocks'   = [holdingXLocks EXCEPT ![to_abort] = {}]
                     /\ waitingForXLock' = [waitingForXLock EXCEPT ![txn]      = key,
                                                                   ![to_abort] = NoLock]
                /\ inConflict'         = [inConflict EXCEPT ![to_abort] = FALSE]
                /\ outConflict'        = [outConflict EXCEPT ![to_abort] = FALSE]
                /\ holdingSIREADlocks' = [holdingSIREADlocks EXCEPT ![to_abort] = {}])
  BY DEF HelperWriteConflictsWithXLock, AgCyc, AgEP, AgEPBody, AgEdges,
         AgPropW, AgXHeld, AgNEPaths

LEMMA AgEdgeChar ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgLockInv, NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key
  PROVE  \A u, v \in TxnId :
            ( /\ u \in ActiveTxns(history)
              /\ v \in ActiveTxns(history)
              /\ AgPropW(txn,key)[v] \in holdingXLocks[u] )
            => <<v, u>> \in AgEdges(txn,key)
<1>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW u \in TxnId, NEW v \in TxnId,
                     u \in ActiveTxns(history), v \in ActiveTxns(history),
                     AgPropW(txn,key)[v] \in holdingXLocks[u]
              PROVE  <<v, u>> \in AgEdges(txn,key)
  OBVIOUS
<1> DEFINE k0 == AgPropW(txn,key)[v]
<1>1. k0 \in Key
  BY DEF AgTypeOK
<1>2. AgXHeld[k0] = u
  <2> DEFINE holder == {t \in ActiveTxns(history) : k0 \in KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn(t)}
  <2>1. u \in holder
    BY DEF KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn
  <2>2. \A t \in holder : t = u
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW t \in holder PROVE t = u
      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. t \in TxnId /\ k0 \in holdingXLocks[t]

    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1, <1>1 DEF AgLockInv
  <2>3. holder # {} /\ (CHOOSE t \in holder : TRUE) = u
    BY <2>1, <2>2
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>1, <2>3 DEF AgXHeld
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2 DEF AgEdges

LEMMA AgEdgeFun ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgLockInv, NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key
  PROVE  \A e \in AgEdges(txn,key) :
            /\ e[1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
            /\ e[2] \in ActiveTxns(history)
            /\ e = <<e[1], e[2]>>
            /\ AgPropW(txn,key)[e[1]] \in holdingXLocks[e[2]]
<1>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW e \in AgEdges(txn,key)
              PROVE  /\ e[1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
                     /\ e[2] \in ActiveTxns(history)
                     /\ e = <<e[1], e[2]>>
                     /\ AgPropW(txn,key)[e[1]] \in holdingXLocks[e[2]]
  OBVIOUS
<1>1. e \in ActiveTxns(history) \X ActiveTxns(history)
  BY DEF AgEdges
<1>2. PICK k \in Key : AgPropW(txn,key)[e[1]] = k /\ AgXHeld[k] = e[2]
  BY DEF AgEdges
<1>3. k \in holdingXLocks[e[2]]
  <2> DEFINE holder == {t \in ActiveTxns(history) : k \in KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn(t)}
  <2>1. AgXHeld[k] = IF holder /= {} THEN CHOOSE t \in holder : TRUE ELSE NoLock
    BY <1>2 DEF AgXHeld
  <2>2. holder # {}
    <3>1. CASE holder = {}
      <4>1. e[2] = NoLock
        BY <2>1, <3>1, <1>2
      <4>2. e[2] \in TxnId
        BY <1>1, AgTxnIds
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, AgNoLockNotKey
    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1
  <2>3. e[2] \in holder
    BY <2>1, <2>2, <1>2
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>3 DEF KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3


AgStepRel(txn) == {pr \in TxnId \X TxnId :
                     pr[1] # txn /\ (pr[2] = txn \/ <<pr[1],pr[2]>> \in AgWaitRel)}

AgPathRel(txn) == {pr \in AgNEPaths \X AgNEPaths :
                     <<pr[1][Len(pr[1])], pr[2][Len(pr[2])]>> \in AgStepRel(txn)}

  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in Nat PROVE <<f[n+2], f[n+1]>> \in AgWaitRel

  <2>1. <<f[(n+1)+1], f[n+1]>> \in AgStepRel(txn)

  <2>2. f[n+1] # txn

  PROVE  FST!IsWellFoundedOn(AgPathRel(txn), AgNEPaths)
<1>1. \A p \in AgNEPaths : p[Len(p)] \in TxnId
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW p \in AgNEPaths PROVE p[Len(p)] \in TxnId
    OBVIOUS
  <2>1. p \in Seq(ActiveTxns(history)) /\ Len(p) > 0

        <5>1. Pth(j+1) \in Seq(ActiveTxns(history)) /\ Len(Pth(j+1)) = (j+1)+1
          BY <4>1, <3>5 DEF AgNEPaths
        <5>2. Pth(j+1) \in [1..Len(Pth(j+1)) -> ActiveTxns(history)]
          BY <5>1, SQT!LenProperties
        <5>3. QED
          BY <5>1, <5>2, <4>1, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>10. QED
        BY <4>6, <4>7, <4>8, <4>9
    <3>7. \A j \in 0..(n1-1) :
             AgPropW(txn,key)[h[j]] \in holdingXLocks[h[j+1]] /\ h[j+1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 0..(n1-1)
                    PROVE  AgPropW(txn,key)[h[j]] \in holdingXLocks[h[j+1]]
                           /\ h[j+1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
        OBVIOUS
      <4>1. j \in Nat /\ (j+1) \in Nat
        BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. <<h[j+1], h[j]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        BY <4>1, <2>3
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>4 DEF AgWaitRelP
    <3> DEFINE D(d) == \A j \in 0..(n1-1) : (j + d = n1 - 1) => AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j)] # {}
    <3>8. D(0)
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in 0..(n1-1), j = n1-1
                    PROVE  AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j)] # {}
        BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>1. h[j+1] = txn
        BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. Pth(j) \in AgNEPaths /\ Pth(j)[Len(Pth(j))] = h[j]
        BY <3>5
      <4>3. h[j] \in ActiveTxns(history) /\ h[j+1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
        BY <3>7, <3>3, <2>4, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>4. AgPropW(txn,key)[Pth(j)[Len(Pth(j))]] \in holdingXLocks[h[j+1]]
        BY <3>7, <4>2
      <4>5. AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j)] = {Pth(j)}
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <4>3, <4>4, AgEPStepVal
      <4>6. QED
        BY <4>5
    <3>9. \A d \in Nat : D(d) => D(d+1)
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW d \in Nat, D(d), NEW j \in 0..(n1-1), j + (d+1) = n1 - 1
                    PROVE  AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j)] # {}
        OBVIOUS
      <4>1. (j+1) \in 0..(n1-1) /\ (j+1) + d = n1-1 /\ j \in 0..(n1-2)
        BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j+1)] # {}
        BY <4>1
      <4>3. h[j+1] # txn
        <5>1. (j+1) \in 1..(n1-1)
          BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2. QED
          BY <5>1, <3>4
      <4>4. Pth(j) \in AgNEPaths /\ Pth(j)[Len(Pth(j))] = h[j]
        BY <3>5
      <4>5. h[j] \in ActiveTxns(history) /\ h[j+1] \in ActiveTxns(history)
        BY <3>7, <2>4, <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>6. AgPropW(txn,key)[Pth(j)[Len(Pth(j))]] \in holdingXLocks[h[j+1]]
        BY <3>7, <4>4
      <4>7. AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(j)] = AgEP(txn,key)[Append(Pth(j), h[j+1])]
        BY <4>3, <4>4, <4>5, <4>6, AgEPStepVal
      <4>8. Append(Pth(j), h[j+1]) = Pth(j+1)
        BY <4>1, <3>6
      <4>9. QED
        BY <4>2, <4>7, <4>8
    <3>10. HIDE DEF D
    <3>11. \A d \in Nat : D(d)
      BY <3>8, <3>9, NI!NatInduction
    <3>12. AgEP(txn,key)[Pth(0)] # {}
      <4>1. (n1-1) \in Nat /\ 0 \in 0..(n1-1) /\ 0 + (n1-1) = n1-1
        BY <3>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. QED
        BY <3>11, <4>1 DEF D
    <3>13. Pth(0) = <<txn>>
      <4>1. Pth(0) = [i \in 1..1 |-> h[i-1]]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>2. \A i \in 1..1 : h[i-1] = txn
        BY <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2
    <3>14. QED
      BY <3>12, <3>13 DEF AgCyc
  <2>7. QED
    BY <2>5, <2>6
<1>. QED
  BY <1>c1, <1>c2

LEMMA AgFiltNoDup ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), AgNoDup(sq), NEW Test(_)
  PROVE  AgNoDup(SelectSeq(sq,Test))
<1> DEFINE fs == SelectSeq(sq,Test)
<1> DEFINE m == Len(fs)
<1> DEFINE n == Len(sq)
<1>2. PICK ff : AgEmb(sq, ff, Test)
  BY AgSelSeqEmbed
<1>3. /\ ff \in [1..m -> 1..n]
      /\ \A i \in 1..m : fs[i] = sq[ff[i]]
      /\ \A i, j \in 1..m : i < j => ff[i] < ff[j]
  BY <1>2 DEF AgEmb
<1>4. \A i \in 1..m : IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, fs[i]) = ff[i]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m PROVE IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, sq[ff[i]]) = ff[i]
    BY <1>3
  <2>1. ff[i] \in 1..n
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, AgIdxUnique
<1>5. QED
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m, NEW j \in 1..m, fs[i] = fs[j]
                PROVE  i = j
    BY DEF AgNoDup
  <2>1. ff[i] = ff[j]
    BY <1>4, <1>3
  <2>2. ~(i < j) /\ ~(j < i)
    BY <1>3, <2>1
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>2, <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r20")

LEMMA AgFiltOrder ==
  ASSUME NEW S, NEW sq \in Seq(S), AgNoDup(sq), NEW Test(_),
         NEW r1 \in Range(SelectSeq(sq,Test)), NEW r2 \in Range(SelectSeq(sq,Test)),
         IndexOfOpInHistory(sq,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(sq,r2)
  PROVE  IndexOfOpInHistory(SelectSeq(sq,Test),r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(SelectSeq(sq,Test),r2)
<1> DEFINE fs == SelectSeq(sq,Test)
<1> DEFINE m == Len(fs)
<1> DEFINE n == Len(sq)
<1>1. fs \in Seq(S)
  BY AgSelSeqType
<1>2. PICK ff : AgEmb(sq, ff, Test)
  BY AgSelSeqEmbed
<1>3. /\ ff \in [1..m -> 1..n]
      /\ \A i \in 1..m : fs[i] = sq[ff[i]]
      /\ \A i, j \in 1..m : i < j => ff[i] < ff[j]
  BY <1>2 DEF AgEmb
<1>4. \A i \in 1..m : IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, fs[i]) = ff[i]
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..m PROVE IndexOfOpInHistory(sq, sq[ff[i]]) = ff[i]
    BY <1>3
  <2>1. ff[i] \in 1..n
    BY <1>3
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, AgIdxUnique
<1>5. /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r1) \in 1..m
      /\ fs[IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r1)] = r1
      /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r2) \in 1..m
      /\ fs[IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r2)] = r2
  BY <1>1, AgIdxIn
<1>6. IndexOfOpInHistory(sq,r1) = ff[IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r1)]
  BY <1>4, <1>5
<1>7. IndexOfOpInHistory(sq,r2) = ff[IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r2)]
  BY <1>4, <1>5
<1>8. QED
  <2> DEFINE a == IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r1)
  <2> DEFINE b == IndexOfOpInHistory(fs,r2)
  <2>1. a \in 1..m /\ b \in 1..m /\ ff[a] < ff[b]
    BY <1>5, <1>6, <1>7
  <2>2. ff[a] \in 1..n /\ ff[b] \in 1..n
    BY <1>3, <2>1
  <2>3. ~(b < a) /\ a # b
    BY <1>3, <2>1, <2>2, TPS!SMTT("r30")
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")

AgWHK(key) == SelectSeq(history, LAMBDA e : e.op = "write" /\ e.key = key)

LEMMA AgWHKFacts ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgNoDup(history), NEW key \in Key
  PROVE  /\ AgWHK(key) \in Seq(AgEvSet)
         /\ AgNoDup(AgWHK(key))

<1>1. history \in Seq(AgEvSet)

<1>2. AgWHK(key) \in Seq(AgEvSet)

  BY <1>2, <1>3, <1>4

LEMMA AgWHKOrder ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgNoDup(history), NEW key \in Key,
         NEW r1 \in Range(AgWHK(key)), NEW r2 \in Range(AgWHK(key)),
         IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r1) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,r2)

LEMMA AgWriteRecInRange ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, NEW t \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key
  PROVE  (AgEvW(t,k) \in Range(history)) <=> (k \in AgWR(t))

  <2>1. AgEvW(t,k) \in SelectEvents(history, LAMBDA e : e.txnid = t /\ e.op = "write")

    BY <2>1 DEF AgWR, KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn, AgEvW

  <2>1. PICK e \in Range(history) : e.txnid = t /\ e.op = "write" /\ e.key = k
    BY <1>2 DEF AgWR, KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn, SelectEvents
  <2>2. e \in AgEvSet

  <2>3. e = AgEvW(t,k)
    BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgEvSet, AgEvW
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>3
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2


AgFCWInv ==
  \A t1, t2 \in TxnId, k \in Key :
     ( /\ t1 # t2
       /\ AgEvW(t1,k) \in Range(history)
       /\ AgEvW(t2,k) \in Range(history)
       /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t1,k)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,k))
       /\ t1 \in CommittedTxns(history) )
     => AgCX(t1) < AgBH(t2)

AgBeginFirst ==
  \A i \in 1..Len(history) : /\ AgEvB(history[i].txnid) \in Range(history)
                            /\ AgBH(history[i].txnid) <= i

LEMMA AgPrefixRange ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, NEW mm \in 1..Len(history)
  PROVE  /\ SubSeq(history,1,mm) \in Seq(AgEvSet)
         /\ Len(SubSeq(history,1,mm)) = mm
         /\ Range(SubSeq(history,1,mm)) = {history[i] : i \in 1..mm}
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgEvSet) /\ Len(history) \in Nat
  BY SQT!LenProperties DEF AgTypeOK
<1>2. \A i \in 1..mm : history[i] \in AgEvSet
  BY <1>1, SQT!ElementOfSeq, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>3. mm \in Int /\ 1 \in Int /\ 1 <= mm
  BY <1>1, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>4. SubSeq(history,1,mm) \in Seq(AgEvSet)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
<1>5. Len(SubSeq(history,1,mm)) = mm
  <2>1. Len(SubSeq(history,1,mm)) = IF 1 <= mm THEN mm - 1 + 1 ELSE 0
    BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>6. \A i \in 1..mm : SubSeq(history,1,mm)[i] = history[i]
  <2>1. \A i \in 1..mm-1+1 : SubSeq(history,1,mm)[i] = history[1+i-1]
    BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>7. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge

LEMMA AgStartTime ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgNoDup(history), NEW t \in TxnId, AgEvB(t) \in Range(history)
  PROVE  /\ AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history)
         /\ history[AgBH(t)] = AgEvB(t)
         /\ StartTime(history, t) = AgBH(t)
<1>1. AgBH(t) \in 1..Len(history) /\ history[AgBH(t)] = AgEvB(t)
  BY AgIdxIn DEF AgBH, AgTypeOK
<1>2. StartTime(history, t) = CHOOSE pos \in 1..Len(history) : history[pos] = AgEvB(t)
  BY DEF StartTime, AgEvB
<1>3. \A pos \in 1..Len(history) : history[pos] = AgEvB(t) => pos = AgBH(t)
  BY <1>1 DEF AgNoDup
<1>4. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

LEMMA AgReadVersion ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgNoDup(history), AgBeginFirst, AgFCWInv, AgLockInv,
         NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key,
         txn \in ActiveTxns(history),
         AgEvB(txn) \in Range(history),
         VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn,key) # {},
         NEW t2 \in TxnId, t2 # txn,
         AgEvW(t2,key) \in Range(history),
         t2 \in CommittedTxns(history),
         AgBH(txn) < AgCX(t2)
  PROVE  t2 \in VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn(txn,key)
<1> DEFINE rv == VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn,key)
<1> DEFINE V == CHOOSE ver \in rv : TRUE
<1> DEFINE whk == AgWHK(key)
<1>hist. history \in Seq(AgEvSet) /\ Len(history) \in Nat
  BY SQT!LenProperties DEF AgTypeOK
<1>bt. AgBH(txn) \in 1..Len(history) /\ history[AgBH(txn)] = AgEvB(txn)
       /\ StartTime(history, txn) = AgBH(txn)
  BY AgStartTime
<1>ct2. AgEvC(t2) \in Range(history) /\ AgCX(t2) \in 1..Len(history)
        /\ history[AgCX(t2)] = AgEvC(t2)
  <2>1. PICK ec \in Range(history) : ec.op \in {"commit"} /\ ec.txnid = t2
    BY DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents
  <2>2. ec \in AgEvSet
    BY <2>1, AgTxnIds
  <2>3. ec = AgEvC(t2)
    BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF AgEvSet, AgEvC
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>3, AgIdxIn, <1>hist DEF AgCX
<1>w2. AgEvW(t2,key) \in Range(history) /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key)) \in 1..Len(history)
  BY AgIdxIn, <1>hist
<1>a. /\ V \in TxnId
      /\ AgEvW(V,key) \in Range(history)
      /\ IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(V,key)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key))
  <2>1. CASE key \in holdingXLocks[txn]
    <3>1. rv = {txn} /\ V = txn
      BY <2>1 DEF VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn
    <3>2. key \in AgWR(txn)
      BY <2>1 DEF AgLockInv
    <3>3. AgEvW(txn,key) \in Range(history)

    <3>4. AgEvW(txn,key) # AgEvW(t2,key)

    <3>5. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key)) # IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key))
      <4>1. history[IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key))] = AgEvW(txn,key)

      <4>2. history[IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key))] = AgEvW(t2,key)

      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <3>4
    <3>6. ~(IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key)))
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key))
                             < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key))
                    PROVE  FALSE
        OBVIOUS
      <4>1. AgCX(t2) < AgBH(txn)
        BY <3>3 DEF AgFCWInv
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1, <1>bt, <1>ct2, <1>hist, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>7. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key))
      <4>1. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(txn,key)) \in 1..Len(history)
        BY <3>3, AgIdxIn, <1>hist
      <4>2. IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,key)) \in 1..Len(history)
        BY AgIdxIn, <1>hist
      <4>3. QED
        BY <3>5, <3>6, <4>1, <4>2, <1>hist, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>8. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>3, <3>7
  <2>2. CASE key \notin holdingXLocks[txn]
    <3> DEFINE pre == SubSeq(history, 1, AgBH(txn))
    <3> DEFINE cw == SelectSeq(pre, LAMBDA e : e.op = "write" /\ e.key = key
                                                /\ e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(pre))
    <3>1. rv = IF Len(cw) = 0 THEN {} ELSE {cw[Len(cw)].txnid}
      BY <2>2, <1>bt
      DEF VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn,

    <3>2. Len(cw) # 0
      BY <3>1
    <3>3. /\ pre \in Seq(AgEvSet)
          /\ Len(pre) = AgBH(txn)
          /\ Range(pre) = {history[i] : i \in 1..AgBH(txn)}
      BY <1>bt, AgPrefixRange
    <3>4. cw \in Seq(AgEvSet) /\ Len(cw) \in Nat
      BY <3>3, AgSelSeqType, SQT!LenProperties
    <3>5. Range(cw) = {e \in Range(pre) : e.op = "write" /\ e.key = key
                                          /\ e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(pre)}
      BY <3>3, AgSelSeqRange
    <3>6. cw[Len(cw)] \in Range(cw)
      <4>1. Len(cw) \in 1..Len(cw)
        BY <3>4, <3>2, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. QED
        BY <4>1, <3>4, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
    <3> DEFINE r0 == cw[Len(cw)]
    <3>7. /\ r0 \in Range(pre)
          /\ r0.op = "write" /\ r0.key = key
          /\ r0.txnid \in CommittedTxns(pre)
      BY <3>5, <3>6
    <3>8. r0 \in Range(history)
      BY <3>7, <3>3, <1>bt, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge, <1>hist
    <3>9. r0 \in AgEvSet /\ r0.txnid \in TxnId
      BY <3>8, AgTxnIds
    <3>10. r0 = AgEvW(r0.txnid, key)
      BY <3>7, <3>9 DEF AgEvSet, AgEvW
    <3>11. V = r0.txnid
      BY <3>1, <3>2
    <3>12. AgEvW(V,key) \in Range(history) /\ V \in TxnId

    <3>13. AgEvC(V) \in Range(pre)
      <4>1. PICK ec \in Range(pre) : ec.op \in {"commit"} /\ ec.txnid = V

      <4>2. ec \in Range(history)
        BY <4>1, <3>3, <1>bt, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge, <1>hist
      <4>3. ec \in AgEvSet
        BY <4>2, AgTxnIds
      <4>4. ec = AgEvC(V)
        BY <4>1, <4>3 DEF AgEvSet, AgEvC
      <4>5. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>4
    <3>14. AgCX(V) <= AgBH(txn)
      <4>1. AgEvC(V) \in Range(history)
        BY <3>13, <3>3, <1>bt, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge, <1>hist
      <4>2. PICK i \in 1..AgBH(txn) : history[i] = AgEvC(V)
        BY <3>13, <3>3
      <4>3. AgCX(V) = i
        <5>1. AgCX(V) \in 1..Len(history) /\ history[AgCX(V)] = AgEvC(V)
          BY <4>1, AgIdxIn, <1>hist DEF AgCX
        <5>2. i \in 1..Len(history)
          BY <4>2, <1>bt, <1>hist, TPS!SMTT("r30")
        <5>3. QED
          BY <5>1, <5>2, <4>2 DEF AgNoDup
      <4>4. QED
        BY <4>2, <4>3
    <3>15. /\ AgBH(V) \in 1..Len(history)
           /\ AgCX(V) \in 1..Len(history)
           /\ AgBH(V) < AgCX(V)
      <4>1. AgEvC(V) \in Range(history)
        BY <3>13, <3>3, <1>bt, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge, <1>hist
      <4>2. AgCX(V) \in 1..Len(history) /\ history[AgCX(V)] = AgEvC(V)
        BY <4>1, AgIdxIn, <1>hist DEF AgCX
      <4>3. history[AgCX(V)].txnid = V
        BY <4>2 DEF AgEvC
      <4>4. AgBH(V) <= AgCX(V)
        BY <4>2, <4>3 DEF AgBeginFirst
      <4>5. AgBH(V) # AgCX(V)
        <5>1. AgEvB(V) \in Range(history)
          BY <4>2, <4>3 DEF AgBeginFirst
        <5>2. history[AgBH(V)] = AgEvB(V)

AgBlockedFCW ==
  \A t \in TxnId : waitingForXLock[t] \in Key =>
     \A t2 \in CommittedTxns(history) :
        AgEvW(t2, waitingForXLock[t]) \in Range(history) => AgCX(t2) < AgBH(t)

AgSireadInv == \A t \in TxnId :
                 holdingSIREADlocks[t] = IF t \in AbortedTxns(history) THEN {} ELSE AgRD(t)

AgWaitActive == \A t \in TxnId : waitingForXLock[t] \in Key => t \in ActiveTxns(history)

AgNoDouble == \A t : ~(t \in CommittedTxns(history) /\ t \in AbortedTxns(history))

AgLastWriter ==
  \A t \in TxnId, k \in Key :
     (t \in ActiveTxns(history) /\ k \in holdingXLocks[t])
     => \A t2 \in TxnId :
          (t2 # t /\ AgEvW(t2,k) \in Range(history))
          => IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t2,k)) < IndexOfOpInHistory(history,AgEvW(t,k))

AgSSI1 == \A t \in CommittedTxns(history) : ~(inConflict[t] /\ outConflict[t])

AgSSI2 == \A t1, t2 \in TxnId : AgPreConc(t1,t2) => (outConflict[t1] /\ inConflict[t2])

AgInv ==

  /\ AgNoDup(history)

        BY <2>0, <3>2, <2>2 DEF AgEPBody
      <4>2. Len(q)..(Len(q)-1) = {}
        BY <2>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>3. QED
        BY <4>1, <4>2, <2>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. CASE edge[2] # txn
      <4> DEFINE w == edge[2]
      <4>1. Append(q, w) \in AgNEPaths /\ <<Append(q, w), q>> \in AgPathRel(txn)
        BY <3>1, <3>3, AgEPStep
      <4>2. Append(q, w) \in FST!SetLessThan(q, AgPathRel(txn), AgNEPaths)
        BY <4>1 DEF FST!SetLessThan
      <4>3. pp \in AgEP(txn,key)[Append(q,w)]
        BY <2>0, <3>3, <2>2 DEF AgEPBody
      <4>4. /\ pp \in AgNEPaths
            /\ Len(Append(q,w)) <= Len(pp)
            /\ \A i \in 1..Len(Append(q,w)) : pp[i] = Append(q,w)[i]
            /\ \A i \in Len(Append(q,w))..(Len(pp)-1) :
                  <<pp[i+1], pp[i]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        BY <4>2, <4>3
      <4>5. /\ w \in ActiveTxns(history)
            /\ AgPropW(txn,key)[from] \in holdingXLocks[w]
        BY <3>1, AgEdgeFun
      <4>6. /\ Len(Append(q,w)) = Len(q)+1
            /\ \A i \in 1..Len(q) : Append(q,w)[i] = q[i]
            /\ Append(q,w)[Len(q)+1] = w
        BY <2>len, <4>5, SQT!AppendProperties
      <4>7. \A i \in 1..Len(q) : pp[i] = q[i]
        BY <4>4, <4>6, <2>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>8. pp[Len(q)+1] = w
        BY <4>4, <4>6, <2>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>9. Len(q) <= Len(pp) /\ Len(pp) \in Nat
        BY <4>4, <4>6, <2>len, SQT!LenProperties, TPS!SMTT("r30") DEF AgNEPaths
      <4>10. <<pp[Len(q)+1], pp[Len(q)]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        <5>1. pp[Len(q)] = from
          BY <4>7, <2>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2. from \in TxnId /\ w \in TxnId
          BY <3>1, AgEdgeFun, AgTxnIds
        <5>3. QED
          BY <4>8, <5>1, <5>2, <4>5 DEF AgWaitRelP
      <4>11. \A i \in Len(q)..(Len(pp)-1) : <<pp[i+1], pp[i]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        <5>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in Len(q)..(Len(pp)-1)
                      PROVE  <<pp[i+1], pp[i]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
          OBVIOUS
        <5>1. CASE i = Len(q)
          BY <5>1, <4>10
        <5>2. CASE i # Len(q)
          <6>1. i \in (Len(q)+1)..(Len(pp)-1)
            BY <5>2, <2>len, <4>9, TPS!SMTT("r30")
          <6>2. QED
            BY <6>1, <4>4, <4>6
        <5>3. QED
          BY <5>1, <5>2
      <4>12. QED
        BY <4>4, <4>7, <4>9, <4>11
    <3>4. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>3. QED
    BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>. HIDE DEF Q
<1>wf. FST!IsWellFoundedOn(AgPathRel(txn), AgNEPaths)
  BY AgPathRelWF
<1>all. \A q \in AgNEPaths : Q(q)
  <2>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW q0 \in AgNEPaths, ~Q(q0) PROVE FALSE
    OBVIOUS
  <2> DEFINE Bad == {q \in AgNEPaths : ~Q(q)}
  <2>1. q0 \in Bad /\ Bad \subseteq AgNEPaths
    OBVIOUS
  <2>2. PICK qm \in Bad : \A y \in Bad : ~(<<y, qm>> \in AgPathRel(txn))
    BY <1>wf, <2>1, FST!WFMin
  <2>3. \A y \in FST!SetLessThan(qm, AgPathRel(txn), AgNEPaths) : Q(y)
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW y \in FST!SetLessThan(qm, AgPathRel(txn), AgNEPaths)

      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. y \in AgNEPaths /\ <<y, qm>> \in AgPathRel(txn)
      BY DEF FST!SetLessThan
    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1, <2>2
  <2>4. QED
    BY <1>st, <2>3, <2>2
<1>. QED
  BY <1>all DEF Q

<1>2. AgPropW(txn,key)[v] \in Key

LEMMA AgElseNoChain ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgLockInv, AgWaitInv, NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key,
         txn \in ActiveTxns(history),

         NEW f \in [Nat -> TxnId],
         \A n \in Nat : <<f[n+1], f[n]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key),

<1>1. CASE \A n \in Nat : f[n] # txn
  BY <1>1, AgNoTxnChain
<1>2. CASE \E n \in Nat : f[n] = txn
  <2>1. PICK n0 \in Nat : f[n0] = txn
    BY <1>2
  <2> DEFINE g == [n \in Nat |-> f[n + n0]]
  <2>2. g \in [Nat -> TxnId] /\ g[0] = txn
    BY <2>1, TPS!SMTT("r30")
  <2>3. \A n \in Nat : <<g[n+1], g[n]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW n \in Nat PROVE <<f[(n+n0)+1], f[n+n0]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
      BY TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>1. (n+n0) \in Nat

    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1
  <2>4. \A n \in Nat : g[n] # to_abort
    BY TPS!SMTT("r30")
  <2> DEFINE pth == CHOOSE anyPathSeq \in AgCyc(txn,key) : TRUE
  <2>5. pth \in AgCyc(txn,key)
    OBVIOUS
  <2>6. <<txn>> \in AgNEPaths
    <3>1. txn \in ActiveTxns(history)
      OBVIOUS
    <3>2. <<txn>> \in Seq(ActiveTxns(history)) /\ Len(<<txn>>) = 1
      BY <3>1
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>2, TPS!SMTT("r30") DEF AgNEPaths
  <2>7. /\ pth \in AgNEPaths
        /\ 1 <= Len(pth)
        /\ pth[1] = txn
        /\ \A i \in 1..(Len(pth)-1) : <<pth[i+1], pth[i]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
    <3>1. \A ppp \in AgEP(txn,key)[<<txn>>] :
             /\ ppp \in AgNEPaths
             /\ Len(<<txn>>) <= Len(ppp)
             /\ \A i \in 1..Len(<<txn>>) : ppp[i] = <<txn>>[i]
             /\ \A i \in Len(<<txn>>)..(Len(ppp)-1) :
                   <<ppp[i+1], ppp[i]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
      BY <2>6, AgEPPathStruct
    <3>2. Len(<<txn>>) = 1 /\ <<txn>>[1] = txn
      OBVIOUS
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>5 DEF AgCyc
  <2>8. Len(pth) \in Nat
    BY <2>7, SQT!LenProperties DEF AgNEPaths
  <2>9. PICK m \in 1..Len(pth) : pth[m] = to_abort
    <3>1. Range(pth) = {pth[i] : i \in 1..Len(pth)}
      BY <2>7, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge DEF AgNEPaths
    <3>2. QED
      BY <3>1
  <2>10. \A i \in 1..Len(pth) : g[i-1] = pth[i]
    <3> DEFINE R(d) == \A i \in 1..Len(pth) : (i = d+1) => g[i-1] = pth[i]
    <3>1. R(0)
      BY <2>2, <2>7
    <3>2. \A d \in Nat : R(d) => R(d+1)
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW d \in Nat, R(d), NEW i \in 1..Len(pth), i = d+2
                    PROVE  g[i-1] = pth[i]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>1. (i-1) \in 1..Len(pth) /\ (i-1) = d+1 /\ (i-1) \in 1..(Len(pth)-1)
        BY <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. g[i-2] = pth[i-1]
        BY <4>1, <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>3. <<pth[i], pth[i-1]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        BY <4>1, <2>7, <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>4. <<g[i-1], g[i-2]>> \in AgWaitRelP(txn,key)
        <5>1. (i-2) \in Nat /\ (i-2)+1 = i-1
          BY <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2. QED
          BY <5>1, <2>3
      <4>5. pth[i] \in TxnId /\ g[i-1] \in TxnId /\ pth[i-1] \in TxnId
        <5>1. (i-1) \in Nat
          BY <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
        <5>2. QED
          BY <4>3, <4>4, <5>1, <2>2 DEF AgWaitRelP
      <4>6. QED
        BY <4>2, <4>3, <4>4, <4>5, AgWaitFun
    <3>3. HIDE DEF R
    <3>4. \A d \in Nat : R(d)
      BY <3>1, <3>2, NI!NatInduction
    <3>5. QED
      <4>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..Len(pth) PROVE g[i-1] = pth[i]
        OBVIOUS
      <4>1. (i-1) \in Nat /\ i = (i-1)+1
        BY <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>2. QED
        BY <3>4, <4>1 DEF R
  <2>11. QED
    <3>1. g[m-1] = to_abort
      BY <2>9, <2>10
    <3>2. (m-1) \in Nat
      BY <2>8, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2, <2>4
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgSuffixRange ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, NEW mm \in 1..Len(history)
  PROVE  Range(SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))) = {history[i] : i \in mm..Len(history)}
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgEvSet) /\ Len(history) \in Nat
  BY SQT!LenProperties DEF AgTypeOK
<1>2. \A i \in mm..Len(history) : history[i] \in AgEvSet
  BY <1>1, SQT!ElementOfSeq, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>3. mm \in Int /\ Len(history) \in Int /\ mm <= Len(history)
  BY <1>1, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>4. SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history)) \in Seq(AgEvSet)
  BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
<1>5. Len(SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))) = Len(history)-mm+1
  <2>1. Len(SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history)))
          = IF mm <= Len(history) THEN Len(history)-mm+1 ELSE 0
    BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
  <2>2. QED
    BY <2>1, <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
<1>6. \A i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1) : SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] = history[mm+i-1]
  BY <1>2, <1>3, SQT!SubSeqProperties
<1>7. Range(SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history)))
        = {SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] : i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1)}
  BY <1>4, <1>5, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
<1>8. QED
  <2>1. \A i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1) :
           SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] \in {history[j] : j \in mm..Len(history)}
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1)
                  PROVE  SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] \in {history[j] : j \in mm..Len(history)}
      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. (mm+i-1) \in mm..Len(history)
      BY <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>2. QED
      BY <1>6, <3>1
  <2>2. \A j \in mm..Len(history) :
           history[j] \in {SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] : i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1)}
    <3>. SUFFICES ASSUME NEW j \in mm..Len(history)
                  PROVE  history[j] \in {SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[i] :
                                           i \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1)}
      OBVIOUS
    <3>1. (j-mm+1) \in 1..(Len(history)-mm+1) /\ mm+(j-mm+1)-1 = j
      BY <1>3, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>2. SubSeq(history,mm,Len(history))[j-mm+1] = history[j]
      BY <3>1, <1>6
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>3. QED
    BY <1>7, <2>1, <2>2

LEMMA AgCPosMono ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgNoDup(history), NEW sfx, AgAppend(sfx), NEW t
  PROVE  \/ AgCPos(t)' = 0
         \/ AgCPos(t)' = AgCPos(t)
         \/ (AgCPos(t) = Len(history)+1 /\ AgCPos(t)' >= Len(history)+1)
<1>hist. history \in Seq(AgEvSet) /\ Len(history) \in Nat
  BY SQT!LenProperties DEF AgTypeOK
<1>f. /\ history' \in Seq(AgEvSet)
      /\ Len(history') = Len(history) + Len(sfx)
      /\ Range(history') = Range(history) \cup Range(sfx)
      /\ AgNoDup(history')
      /\ \A r \in Range(history) : IndexOfOpInHistory(history', r) = IndexOfOpInHistory(history, r)
  BY AgAppendFacts
<1>len. Len(sfx) \in Nat /\ Len(history') \in Nat
  BY <1>f, SQT!LenProperties DEF AgAppend
<1>1. CASE t \in AbortedTxns(history')
  BY <1>1 DEF AgCPos
<1>2. CASE t \notin AbortedTxns(history')
  <2>1. t \notin AbortedTxns(history)
    BY <1>2, <1>f DEF AbortedTxns, SelectEvents
  <2>2. CASE AgEvC(t) \in Range(history)
    <3>1. AgCPos(t) = AgCX(t) /\ AgCPos(t)' = AgCX(t)'
      BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>2, <1>f DEF AgCPos
    <3>2. AgCX(t)' = AgCX(t)
      BY <2>2, <1>f DEF AgCX
    <3>3. QED
      BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>3. CASE AgEvC(t) \notin Range(history)
    <3>1. AgCPos(t) = Len(history)+1
      BY <1>2, <2>1, <2>3 DEF AgCPos
    <3>2. CASE AgEvC(t) \in Range(history')
      <4>1. AgCPos(t)' = AgCX(t)'
        BY <1>2, <3>2 DEF AgCPos
      <4>2. AgCX(t)' \in 1..Len(history')
        BY <3>2, <1>f, AgIdxIn DEF AgCX
      <4>4. AgCX(t)' > Len(history)
        <5>1. history'[AgCX(t)'] = AgEvC(t)
          BY <3>2, <1>f, AgIdxIn DEF AgCX
        <5>2. \A i \in 1..Len(history) : history'[i] = history[i]
          BY AgAppendFacts
        <5>3. \A i \in 1..Len(history) : history'[i] \in Range(history)
          BY <5>2, <1>hist, SQT!RangeEquality, AgRangeBridge
        <5>4. QED
          BY <4>2, <5>1, <5>3, <2>3, <1>hist, <1>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
      <4>5. QED
        BY <3>1, <4>1, <4>2, <4>4, <1>hist, <1>len, <1>f, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>3. CASE AgEvC(t) \notin Range(history')
      <4>1. AgCPos(t)' = Len(history')+1
        BY <1>2, <3>3 DEF AgCPos
      <4>2. QED
        BY <3>1, <4>1, <1>f, <1>hist, <1>len, TPS!SMTT("r30")
    <3>4. QED
      BY <3>2, <3>3
  <2>4. QED
    BY <2>2, <2>3
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgPreConcBack ==

  <2>1. \/ AgCPos(tb)' = 0
        \/ AgCPos(tb)' = AgCPos(tb)
        \/ (AgCPos(tb) = Len(history)+1 /\ AgCPos(tb)' >= Len(history)+1)

LEMMA AgWaitShrink ==
  ASSUME AgTypeOK, AgWaitInv,
         \A t \in TxnId : waitingForXLock'[t] = waitingForXLock[t] \/ waitingForXLock'[t] = NoLock,
         \A t \in TxnId : holdingXLocks'[t] \subseteq holdingXLocks[t]

    BY DEF AgWaitRel
  <2>2. pr[1] \in TxnId /\ pr[2] \in TxnId
    BY <2>1
